description: How the site is used and what it holds: readers, searches, the viewer's IIIF libraries, manuscripts and the MEI pipeline.

spec.title: Zero-hit searches
spec.description: Share of searches that found nothing, over the selected time range.

spec.title: Results per search
spec.description: How many chants searches match (all clients, selected time range).

spec.title: How deep readers page
spec.description: Offset of each page of results requested (0 = first page).

spec.title: Notation searches by type and outcome
spec.description: Neume, pitch, contour and interval searches.

spec.title: Suggestions by field and outcome
spec.description: Search-as-you-type requests (all clients).

spec.title: Manifest loads by manuscript and outcome
spec.description: Viewer manifest fetches through the proxy over the selected time range.

spec.expr: sum by (manuscript_id, outcome) (increase(cantus_viewer_manifest_loads_total{env="production", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"}[$__range])) * on (manuscript_id) group_left (siglum, name) max by (manuscript_id, siglum, name) (cantus_manuscript_info{env="production"})

spec.title: Manifest fetch failures by library
spec.description: Share of fetches that failed per upstream host. Gallica is blocked by BnF's Cloudflare.

spec.expr: sum by (upstream_host) (rate(cantus_external_requests_total{env="production", target="manifest_proxy", outcome!="success"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (upstream_host) (rate(cantus_external_requests_total{env="production", target="manifest_proxy"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Manifest fetches by library and outcome
spec.description: Fetches per second to each IIIF host.

spec.title: External fetch p95 by target
spec.description: Manifest proxy, IIIF mapping and CANTUS Database calls.

spec.title: Page loads by page
spec.description: Full HTML loads of the app shell or a static page.

spec.title: Manuscripts
spec.description: Public manuscripts and those with chants loaded. Mapped = folios with an image.

spec.expr: max by (manuscript_id, siglum, name, public) (cantus_manuscript_info{env="production", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"})
max by (manuscript_id) (cantus_folios_with_image{env="production", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"}) / max by (manuscript_id) (cantus_folios{env="production", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"})

spec.title: Solr vs database
spec.description: Records per type in Postgres and documents in Solr; they should match (CantusSolrIndexIncomplete fires below 99%).

spec.title: Visibility mismatch per manuscript
spec.description: Chants whose visibility in Solr differs from their manuscript's; should be 0.

spec.expr: max by (manuscript_id) (cantus_solr_chant_visibility_mismatch{env="production", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"}) * on (manuscript_id) group_left (siglum, name) max by (manuscript_id, siglum, name) (cantus_manuscript_info{env="production"})

spec.title: Imports and mappings
spec.description: Chant imports from CANTUS Database and folio-to-image mapping runs, by outcome, over the selected time range.

spec.title: Submissions by status
spec.description: MEI deposits in the database now.

spec.title: Deposits received
spec.description: Deposits over the selected time range, by outcome and rejection reason.

spec.title: Oldest waiting
spec.description: Oldest submission awaiting review (CantusMEIReviewOverdue at 14 days) and oldest publication in flight (CantusMEIPublishingStuck at 1 hour).

spec.title: Reviews by action
spec.description: Review decisions over the selected time range.

spec.title: Requests by client type
spec.description: All Django requests per second, stacked by who sent them. Ignores the client filter, to show the bot share.

spec.title: Review latency
spec.description: Time from a deposit arriving to its review decision, over the selected time range.

spec.title: Publish runs
spec.description: Publication task runs by outcome over the selected time range.

spec.title: Manuscripts opened (top 10)
spec.description: Manuscript-detail loads in the viewer over the selected time range.

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (manuscript_id) (increase(cantus_manuscript_views_total{env="production", client=~"$client", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"}[$__range])) * on (manuscript_id) group_left (siglum, name) max by (manuscript_id, siglum, name) (cantus_manuscript_info{env="production"}))

spec.title: Folio page turns per manuscript
spec.description: Folios displayed in the viewer per second.

spec.expr: sum by (manuscript_id) (rate(cantus_folio_views_total{env="production", client=~"$client", manuscript_id=~"$manuscript"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (manuscript_id) group_left (siglum, name) max by (manuscript_id, siglum, name) (cantus_manuscript_info{env="production"})

spec.description: Chant lists fetched for a displayed folio, by whether the folio had any chants (selected time range).
